description:
Jiangjin Cuiya is a green tea named for Jiangjin district in Chongqing. It appears in round-ups of China's named teas, and almost nothing more is on record.

The name means 'Jiangjin emerald bud', which hints at a young, bud-based style. That is a reading of the name, not a documented recipe.

If you come across it, brew it as a tender green with cooler water and short steeps, then decide for yourself. Ask who made it and when it was picked, since no published description exists to check it against.
history: Little is documented. The tea is named in a general list of Chinese teas among Chongqing's entries, without a maker, date or origin story.
